name: yao_open_prompts
description: A practical bilingual AI prompt library designed to support prompt engineering for work, learning, content creation, marketing, and everyday applications.

inputs.name: prompt_context
inputs.description: Context or topic description to guide the prompt generation.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Language indicator (e.g., English or Chinese) to choose the appropriate bilingual prompt.

inputs.name: user_intent
inputs.description: The intended task or goal for the AI prompt (e.g., writing, summarizing, marketing).

outputs.name: ai_prompt
outputs.description: Generated bilingual AI prompt tailored to the provided context, language, and user intent.

steps: Identify user intent and application domain (work, learning, marketing, content, or daily use).
Select the bilingual prompt template matching the intent and language preference.
Customize the prompt template by injecting the specific context or parameters.
Generate the final AI prompt in the specified language for usage with an AI model.
Utilize the generated prompt to interact with AI for the target outcome.
use_cases: Generating marketing copy or advertisements in English and Chinese.
Creating bilingual content and learning materials for educational purposes.
Constructing AI prompts to assist in workplace automation or task completion.
Developing tailored AI prompts to aid in daily personal productivity.
Enhancing prompt engineering workflows with ready-to-use bilingual templates.
patterns: Bilingual prompt templates with parallel English-Chinese versions
Reusable prompt templates for diverse scenarios
Prompt engineering for marketing, content generation, and learning
Structured prompt format to standardize AI interactions

prompt_templates.name: content_creation
prompt_templates.template: Create a detailed and engaging article on the topic: {prompt_context}. Please write in {language}.

prompt_templates.name: marketing_ad_copy
prompt_templates.template: Generate persuasive marketing ad copy for the product/service: {prompt_context} in {language}.

prompt_templates.name: learning_material
prompt_templates.template: Provide an educational explanation or summary about: {prompt_context} in {language} suitable for learners.

prompt_templates.name: daily_use_assistant
prompt_templates.template: Assist with the following daily task or question: {prompt_context}. Use {language}.
